key: ...Um, could you maybe go away?
en: ...Um, could you maybe go away?
ja: ……あの、向こうに行ってもらえますか?

key: SHELLY: Huh, don't you want to be free? The cell is open now!
en: SHELLY: Huh, don't you want to be free? The cell is open now!
ja: シェリー: え、自由になりたくないの? 独房はもう開いてるよ!

key: CHILD: This is the only space I have... It's mine, and it's supposed to be safe... Could you please go?
en: CHILD: This is the only space I have... It's mine, and it's supposed to be safe... Could you please go?
ja: 子供: ここしか、僕の居場所がないんです……ここは僕のもので、安全なはずなんです……お願いだから、行ってください。

key: SHELLY: S-sorry...
en: SHELLY: S-sorry...
ja: シェリー: ご、ごめんね……

key: Can I be let out now?
en: Can I be let out now?
ja: 今、出してもらえますか?

key: SHELLY: Oh, I-- I wish I could...
en: SHELLY: Oh, I-- I wish I could...
ja: シェリー: あ、そ、それが……できたらいいんだけど……

key: I'm sorry!
en: I'm sorry!
ja: ごめんね!

key: NOEL: Hi.
en: NOEL: Hi.
ja: ノエル: やあ。

key: Heather is upstairs.
en: Heather is upstairs.
ja: ヘザーは上の階にいるよ。

key: That's where the Doctor works.
en: That's where the Doctor works.
ja: そこが、ドクターの仕事場だ。

key: I'm fine.
en: I'm fine.
ja: 僕は大丈夫。

key: I'm used to being locked in here.
en: I'm used to being locked in here.
ja: ここに閉じ込められるのには慣れてる。

key: NOEL: The monitoring station is upstairs too.
en: NOEL: The monitoring station is upstairs too.
ja: ノエル: 監視室も上の階にある。

key: You can unlock this door from there.
en: You can unlock this door from there.
ja: そこから、このドアの鍵を開けられるよ。

key: NOEL: You haven't gotten Heather?
en: NOEL: You haven't gotten Heather?
ja: ノエル: まだヘザーを助け出せてないのか?

key: SHELLY: The door upstairs was locked...
en: SHELLY: The door upstairs was locked...
ja: シェリー: 上のドアに鍵がかかってて……

key: NOEL: Oh. Right. I think there's a spare key for that in the Doctor's private library, but that's usually locked.
en: NOEL: Oh. Right. I think there's a spare key for that in the Doctor's private library, but that's usually locked.
ja: ノエル: ああ、そうか。たしか、ドクターの書斎に予備の鍵があったはずだけど、そこもたいてい鍵がかかってる。

key: SHELLY: So what do we do?
en: SHELLY: So what do we do?
ja: シェリー: じゃあ、どうすればいいの?

key: NOEL: I'm going downstairs. Maybe Anna will have an idea.
en: NOEL: I'm going downstairs. Maybe Anna will have an idea.
ja: ノエル: 僕は下に行ってみる。アンナなら何か考えがあるかもしれない。

key: ORDERLY: So it's you doing this, \PN.
en: ORDERLY: So it's you doing this, \PN.
ja: 職員: これをやっていたのは、お前か、\PN。

key: When you were here before, you were just staking out the place?
en: When you were here before, you were just staking out the place?
ja: 前にここに来た時は、下見をしていただけだったのか?

key: Our responsibility to the children of Reborn will not be shaken.
en: Our responsibility to the children of Reborn will not be shaken.
ja: リボーンの子どもたちに対する我々の責任は、揺らぐことはない。

key: We will do as we must to protect them.
en: We will do as we must to protect them.
ja: 彼らを守るために、必要なことをするまでだ。

key: SHELLY: Is torturing them protection?
en: SHELLY: Is torturing them protection?
ja: シェリー: 拷問することが、守ることなの?

key: I think you need to ask yourself who the real bad guy is...
en: I think you need to ask yourself who the real bad guy is...
ja: 本当の悪者が誰なのか、自分に問いかけてみたら?

key: ORDERLY: Torture is an unfair and uneducated assessment of our therapeutic techniques.
en: ORDERLY: Torture is an unfair and uneducated assessment of our therapeutic techniques.
ja: 職員: 拷問とは、我々の治療技術に対する、不公平で無知な評価だ。

key: You are but children who do not understand research and progress.
en: You are but children who do not understand research and progress.
ja: お前たちは、研究と進歩を理解できない、ただの子どもに過ぎない。

key: This is no place for you to meddle!
en: This is no place for you to meddle!
ja: ここは、お前たちが口を出す場所ではない!

key: Protection? You bring only violence.
en: Protection? You bring only violence.
ja: 守る、だと? お前が持ち込むのは暴力だけだ。

key: Our real responsibility is to do as we are told.
en: Our real responsibility is to do as we are told.
ja: あたしたちの本当の責任は、言われたとおりにすることなんだよね。

key: ORDERLY: Your heroism is all foolhardiness and spectacle.
en: ORDERLY: Your heroism is all foolhardiness and spectacle.
ja: 職員: お前の英雄気取りなど、無謀な見世物に過ぎない。

key: We're the ones who can make a real difference.
en: We're the ones who can make a real difference.
ja: 本当の変化を生み出せるのは、我々の方だ。

key: ORDERLY: Our job was done as best as we could do it.
en: ORDERLY: Our job was done as best as we could do it.
ja: 職員: 我々の仕事は、できる限り最善を尽くしてやり遂げた。

key: ORDERLY: If only ideals and vainglory were enough to do anything.
en: ORDERLY: If only ideals and vainglory were enough to do anything.
ja: 職員: 理想と虚栄心だけで、何かを成し遂げられるとでも思っているのか。

key: Unlock?
en: Unlock?
ja: 解錠しますか?

key: ERROR-- ACCESS DENIED
en: ERROR-- ACCESS DENIED
ja: エラー――アクセス拒否

key: PLEASE SCAN IDENTIFICATION
en: PLEASE SCAN IDENTIFICATION
ja: 身分証をスキャンしてください

key: PATIENT CELLS DISENGAGED
en: PATIENT CELLS DISENGAGED
ja: 患者用独房、解錠完了

key: PATIENT CELLS ALREADY OPEN
en: PATIENT CELLS ALREADY OPEN
ja: 患者用独房はすでに開いています

key: ECT CHAMBER
en: ECT CHAMBER
ja: 電気けいれん療法室

key: PATIENT QUARTERS
en: PATIENT QUARTERS
ja: 患者用居室

key: Cancel
en: Cancel
ja: キャンセル
